text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py, reserve_stock now validates warehouse_id as its first check, before SKU/qty validation and before the ledger is loaded. A module-level regex r'^WH-[A-Z]+-\\d{2}$' (matching the 'WH-REGION-NN' format of real warehouse codes like 'WH-NVL-03') rejects malformed codes such as 'WH7' with a plain ValueError (\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\"), so nothing is appended to or saved in the ledger on rejection. Valid-format codes, including pending reservations for valid warehouses with no lots, pass through unchanged; no other code was modified.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
